title: DND alert settings (Android 8.1)
body:
Hi there,
on Android 8.1 there are the follwoing notification options:
Sounds on --> all notifications have an acoustic signal 
Sounds "on" but volume to "0" (minimum) --> virbation for all notifactions
DND mode: Depending on my volume setting (vibrating or sound) only notifications I gave permission to are active. For my "high" / "low" alerts I gave  permission to override DND mode (in the Android notification settings). So there should be vibration when volume is set to "0" in DND mode and there should be a sound when in DND mode and volume is >"0".
In addition, in XDrip I would have the "override silent mode" option so that a pericular XDrip notification should give a sound even when having set volume to 0.

However, when I am in DND mode (volume set to >0) there's only vibration for XDrip notifications.. 
I know that it worked on some previous nightly (maybe one year ago).
How can I make XDrip sounds work the way I described above? can it be that there's a bug in the XDrip alerts?
Thanks for your help in advance.

edit: Is there a way to enable / customize notification lights for XDrip alerts?
